zh.chartTitle: 本季度营收「稳健增长」？单位：万元

textRefs.debunk_axis2: Y 轴起点被抬到 1000 万——Q1-Q3 的「增长」被视觉放大了好几倍！真实起点是 0，前三季度其实只是缓慢爬坡。
textRefs.debunk_quarter: Q4 这根柱（480 万）被刻意放在图表下方压低——如果把它算进全年，所谓「稳健增长」就变成了「年底大跌」。

manual: 检查 Y 轴起点是不是 0
所有的数据都画进图里了吗？
hints: 看看 Y 轴从几开始——0 才是诚实的起点
有没有哪根柱子被故意矮化或藏起来了？
zh.explanation: 这张营收图动了两个手脚：①Y 轴从 1000 万起，把前三季度的小幅爬坡放大成「稳健增长」；②把暴跌的 Q4 柱压在最底下，让读者忽略全年其实是下跌的。看营收图先问：轴从哪里开始？柱子是全的吗？

en.chartTitle: This Quarter's Revenue "Steady Growth"? Unit: 10k CNY

textRefs.debunk_axis2: The Y axis starts at 10 million — the Q1-Q3 "growth" is visually amplified several times! The honest baseline is 0; the first three quarters were just a slow crawl.
textRefs.debunk_quarter: The Q4 bar (4.8 million) is deliberately pushed down at the bottom of the chart — count it into the annual total and the "steady growth" becomes a year-end plunge.

manual: Check whether the Y axis starts at 0
Is every data point actually in the chart?
hints: Look at where the Y axis starts — 0 is the honest baseline
Is any bar deliberately shrunk or hidden?
en.explanation: This revenue chart cheats twice: ① the Y axis starts at 10 million, amplifying the first three quarters' small climb into "steady growth"; ② the plunging Q4 bar is squashed at the bottom so readers miss that the year is actually down. When reading a revenue chart, ask: where does the axis start? are all the bars there?
